<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (+1 peak ~12.5 %) suggests about 12 carbons. The formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂ has a monoisotopic neutral mass of 192.1150 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ of 193.1223 Da, which is within a few millidaltons of the observed value and matches the isotopic pattern well. Therefore the molecular formula is C12H16O2. </thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
